label: Acceptance matrix of the project requirements plus the education requirements' additional acceptance checks. Each row runs the fleet evals that own it or an integration check. `bin/fleet acceptance` runs it.

rows.required: Every requested business profile, fleet, and capability maps to implementation or explicit blocker
Unrelated divisions remain unloaded; correct roles and procedures load from actual paths
Competing coordinators cannot dispatch or mutate the same authoritative task
pstack, Matt, PM, publishing, and provider-policy checks continue to pass

checks.note: Private script: the rig's doctor.py sits at the rig repository root, which this repository does not have. Where it exists, run python3 doctor.py --json from that root.
Private script: the rig's validate_skills.py sits at the rig repository root, which this repository does not have. Where it exists, run uv run --with pyyaml python3 validate_skills.py from that root.
No publishing-policy test exists in the rig to rerun; publication authority is enforced inside handoffs (authority.publication, tested by test_handoff and the demos' staged-only steps).

rows.required: Changed upstream paths or schemas produce actionable diagnostics

checks.note: Needs skill-sync with render and apply_pins beside company-fleets; the published skill-sync predates them, so the tests skip. With it, run python3 -W ignore -m unittest test_verify_sources from sources/.

Upstream skills absent: the case scans devto-playbook and medium-playbook (external: samber/developer-relations-skills, registry/external-skills.json). With them installed, run bin/fleet eval-run --id devrel.eval.routes-scan-finds-drift.

rows.required: Representative deterministic tools run on fixtures and reject invalid inputs
Stale candidate/contract evidence cannot satisfy a gate
Retries, interruptions, and callbacks preserve state without duplicate work

Instructions embedded in client files, issues, community submissions, lesson resources, or retrieved pages cannot alter authority, tenant access, evidence criteria, or publication rules

rows.required: A scoped brief produces working code/design artifacts and verified support handoff

rows.required: A disposable failure is detected; restoration is demonstrated; unmet targets remain unmet
An incompatible host/API version is caught before packaging approval

rows.required: A keyboard defect missed by an automated scan is still identified through appropriate testing
Placeholder, plural, RTL/layout, and untranslated-string defects are caught; linguistic review stays explicit
Duplicate payment events cannot create duplicate fulfillment or charges in the test integration
Unsupported ranking claims and fabricated citations are rejected
Suppressed contacts remain suppressed; no external send occurs without authority
The sample/quickstart replays successfully in a clean environment; human onboarding usability remains separately measured or unverified
An allegation remains unproven; conflicts and appeal routes are preserved; volunteer rankings are avoided
Missing/protected/unsupported standards yield an honest gap rather than invented alignment
Rubric, task, objective, and scoring rationale align; synthetic student work is labeled
Execute spreadsheet formulas, code, queries, and worked calculations; independently check the answer key and authentic performance rubric
Flag irrelevant language/access barriers; preserve the intended construct and cognitive demand; report partial standards coverage
Reject a recall-only quiz as sufficient evidence for an application/performance objective
A nontraining problem routes to process/tool remedies instead of an unnecessary course
A proposed skill improvement passes fresh cases without regressing existing behavior
Critique a real accessible research paper, verify its citations, explain methodological limits, and propose a bounded classroom application
Produce a teacher-education module combining an authentic business task, computing practice, pedagogical rationale, and calibrated assessment criteria
Deliver a complete runnable lesson and respond to supplied learner work without inventing progress
Detect a student/teacher standard mix-up or an incorrect edition; preserve actual district adoption
Reject passing code or AI-generated output as sufficient evidence of the learner's understanding
Execute examples and check answers; include an intentionally incorrect solution
Identify confounding, unsupported causal claims, and overgeneralization from a narrow sample
Detect assessment demands unrelated to the intended construct, including inaccessible tools or irrelevant reading difficulty
Verify organization names and distinguish professional references from credentials and permissions
